notes:
• Account background: Hushwing runs a real-time bidding exchange for DOOH and mobile programmatic. Auctions are sub-120ms P95 budget; per-auction environment is extremely cost-sensitive — want to minimize cost-per-decision.
• Primary ask: proof that Redwood can meet 50-120ms P95 at ~4k-6k qps with model variants (7B quantized and 13B fallback). Interested in clear unit-cost numbers and recommended batching + caching settings.
• Technical constraints: can't tolerate batching that adds >20ms extra latency; however short prefix caching for repeated ad-context is acceptable. Heavy interest in prefix/KV cache + dynamic batching controls.
• Quantization interest: aggressive int4/LLM-GPTQ-style quantization for 7B to hit throughput targets; want Redwood guidance on accuracy delta and recommended profiles.
• Perf benchmarking request: Redwood to run perf lab using supplied traffic profile (token histograms attached), evaluate: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, CPU/GPU utilization, and per-token cost breakdown for hosted vs dedicated. Include experiments: no-batching, micro-batching (batch size 2-8), dynamic batching with latency SLO 80ms, with/without KV cache, int8 vs int4 quant models.
• Compliance: require SSO (SAML), KMS integration for key management, audit logs with 1y retention, and a confirmation of tenant isolation on dedicated pools. Data residency discussion for EU impressions (they have EU inventory).
• Quote from CTO on call: "If we miss auctions by 40ms we lose revenue — can't accept flaky P95s."
• POC plan: 2-week bench run -> internal evaluation -> 1-month pilot on dedicated pool -> procurement. Expected decision timeline: Apr 2026.
• Stated cost target: reduce per-decision cost by ~2.5-3x vs current self-hosted stack while keeping same or better latency.
• Attachments: traffic_profile_v1.csv, token_histogram.png (Drive links above).
• Notes style: shorthand, action items assigned in timeline.
